# Stills fixtures

`anim.webp` is an animated, lossless WebP of three 16x12 solid frames, red
for 300 ms, green for 300 ms and blue for 400 ms, looping. It was made on
2026-10-10 from three PNG frames written by the Python standard library,
with libwebp 1.6.0's `img2webp -loop 0 -lossless -d 300 f1.png -d 300 f2.png
-d 400 f3.png`.
